fees_note: Cherokee NF page (read 2026-11-07; page last updated 2025-03-20): $8 a site a night, 11 sites; at most 5 people and 2 vehicles a site; no extra-vehicle charge stated. First-come, first-served.
note: Small (11-site) primitive Cherokee NF campground along North River, ~3 mi up gravel FR 217 off FR 210 from Tellico Plains. Drive-in; FS notes 'Sites 2 and 3 are ideal for mid-sized campers and trailers' and sites 4-6 for mid/smaller rigs (firsthand report of a 25-ft truck camper; low branches a caveat for tall rigs). Vault toilets, no potable water; bear food storage. FCFS only, open year-round. Operated by Cherokee National Forest (Tellico River Ranger District). --Claude

fees_note: Cherokee NF page (read 2026-11-07; page last updated 2025-03-24): $6 a site a night; at most 5 people and 2 vehicles a site; no extra-vehicle charge stated. First-come, first-served; pay on site by cash/check or Recreation.gov Scan & Pay.
note: Primitive USFS campground on Citico Creek, Cherokee NF (Tellico Ranger District). 7 sites, standard nonelectric -- no hookups, no potable water (bring your own), vault toilet. Each site has picnic table, fire ring/grill, lantern post. Firsthand report: gravel road passable by normal vehicles (no 4WD), sites fairly level, Site 2 best for RVs. FCFS -- no advance reservations; pay on-site by cash/check or Recreation.gov Scan-and-Pay QR. Open roughly March-November (2025: Mar 6-Nov 17). Max 5 people per site; horses not allowed. RV Life: 0* / $ (unrated). --Claude

fees_note: BLM Burns District page (read 2026-11-07): $16 a night per vehicle, where one vehicle is a single car, truck, or RV with its towed vehicle; additional passenger vehicles $5 a night. First-come, first-served; pay cash or check at the kiosk.
note: BLM Burns District campground on the west side of Steens Mountain (Steens Mtn Cooperative Management Area). 36 family sites amid juniper/sage plus an adjacent 15-site equestrian loop with corrals; general campground, not equestrian-only. Vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups. First-come, first-served; typically open mid-May through mid-November. Trailheads (Big Indian Gorge, Little Blitzen) at the campground. --Claude

fees_note: Mohave County Parks fee schedule and Davis Camp page (read 2026-11-07): dry/beach camping (tent or RV, no hookups, 14-night max, first-come) $20 a night per vehicle, the fee based on 4 people a vehicle, $5 each additional person; RV Campground A water/electric $40 a night; B, C and D full hookup $45 a night ($225 a week, $600 a month); the B/C/D section pages still show $40. Day use $12 a vehicle; watercraft launching $10.
